pr_title: ddl: split range group for each index separately for global sort import
pr_body:

### What problem does this PR solve?
<!--

Please create an issue first to describe the problem.

There MUST be one line starting with "Issue Number:  " and
linking the relevant issues via the "close" or "ref".

For more info, check https://pingcap.github.io/tidb-dev-guide/contribute-to-tidb/contribute-code.html#referring-to-an-issue.

-->

Issue Number: close #50657

Problem Summary: 

There may be too many `multiFileStat`. It is easy to reach the file limit supported by global sort, especially in scenarios with multi-schema changes.

https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/blob/9f5d2160b108efb953327a5ccad09c3b160b7403/pkg/ddl/backfilling_dist_scheduler.go#L356-L357

### What changed and how does it work?

When using multi-schema change to add multiple indexes, we split the range group for each index separately.
